description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractInstallerRestController' for a REST API within the OrangeHRM installer module. It provides a template for handling HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with common error handling, content-type processing, and response formatting, but leaves specific request handling methods to be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerRestController
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a REST API template with methods to process different HTTP methods and shared error handling logic. Designed to be extended for specific installer REST controllers.
